## Body

2026-11-10: spoonbill's held compacts at 16:28, 16:33 and 16:42 were all dropped, though the memory turn was answered each time; no session.compaction event, and it stayed at 706k to 723k. The prime's guess: a stale 'Working' pane state never counts as settled for Copilot's typed compact. Its pane also showed MallocStackLogging noise over the input. The receipt 'held — memory-turn' proves nothing. Always verify with session.compaction_complete in the seat's events.jsonl. After one drop, don't keep re-sending: tell the prime and the seat's parent with the evidence (times, size, memory note and handover paths). The fix there was a fresh reviewer seat. F180 tracks it.
